explication: Stripe AI combines billing-aware LLM integrations with agent toolkits that expose Stripe MCP tools to framework-specific callers. A principal workflow is: an agent toolkit connects to Stripe’s remote MCP service, discovers tools, converts their schemas for its framework, and dispatches calls. The repository also includes token-usage metering, an MCP server package, and Claude plugin lifecycle scripts. Edges reflect README statements and shown imports/calls; unsampled integrations and plugin behavior are not inferred.
